name: Malin's Request
summary: In Stormwind, Archmage Malin asks for help recovering relics from fallen Stromgarde. He sends seasoned Alliance adventurers north to Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands, where an expedition seeks the magical relics left behind when Stromgarde fell.

sections.title: A Master's Lost Belongings
sections.body: Archmage Malin serves in Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum and acts for his former mentor, Archmage Trelane. When Stromgarde fell into chaos, Trelane made a desperate stand at the Tower of Arathor. As hostile forces took the city, he had to abandon his post and leave powerful enchanted possessions behind. Malin fears those relics may fall into hostile hands. He sends capable mercenaries north to strengthen his agents in the field and reclaim Trelane's lost belongings.

sections.title: The Strained Outpost at Refuge Pointe
sections.body: Refuge Pointe lies on the road to Trelane's relics, in the central Arathi Highlands. The outpost is a hard-pressed refuge for Stromgarde loyalists, and Malin's chief contact there is the dwarf Skuerto. Syndicate outlaws, Witherbark trolls, and Boulderfist ogres press the outpost from every side. When you arrive, Skuerto and the garrison are stretched too thin to welcome you warmly without immediate help.

faq.answer: Archmage Malin is a human wizard in Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum. Once an apprentice to Archmage Trelane of Stromgarde, he now directs efforts from Stormwind to recover his mentor's magical research.

faq.q: Why does Malin need help in Arathi?
faq.answer: Stromgarde fell under siege, forcing Archmage Trelane to flee the Tower of Arathor. Malin's agents are trying to recover Trelane's abandoned relics, but they are overwhelmed and need reinforcements.
Skuerto is a dwarf scout stationed at Refuge Pointe, an Alliance encampment on the main trade road through the central Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: What happened to the Tower of Arathor?
faq.answer: The Tower of Arathor was an arcane stronghold in Stromgarde. As the kingdom fell, Archmage Trelane tried to hold it against Syndicate rogues and Boulderfist ogres, but its defenses failed and he had to flee.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Skuerto?
faq.answer: Skuerto is overwhelmed and dismissive when you arrive. He sends you to his companions at Refuge Pointe to begin recovering Trelane's scattered belongings.
Archmage Trelane is a prominent Stromgarde mage and Archmage Malin's mentor. He was among the key defenders of the Arathi capital before the kingdom fell.

angles.text: As a mage visiting the Wizard's Sanctum, you can help Malin preserve precious arcane research and relics tied to Arathor's mages.
As an Alliance member, you can help strengthen Refuge Pointe, the Alliance's fragile remaining foothold in Arathi.
As a human, you can help recover the treasures of Stromgarde, the cradle of human civilization, and preserve the heritage of Arathor.
